title: RBAC v2: authoritative fixture comparator and flake detector
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Build an authoritative fixture comparator and flakiness detector to improve RBAC v2 permission test reliability and to surface regressions in audit/log output. This ticket delivers a lightweight comparator that ingests canonical permission snapshots (authoritative fixtures) and live assertion traces from the service, computes a prioritized delta, and exports telemetry suitable for regression alerts and postmortem analysis. The goal is to reduce noisy failures in the golden/regression pipeline and to provide a reproducible path from failing assertion to root cause (policy, cache, kernel scheduling, or SSO mapping).
acceptance_criteria: Comparator ingests authoritative fixture format v2 and produces deterministic deltas for ACL, role bindings, and derived permissions
Flake detector assigns a reproducible flakiness score for each failing assertion based on frequency, source host, and KV cache state
Pipeline hooks created so comparator output becomes an input to existing regression suite and to console alerts
End-to-end test validating a seeded regression (intentional permission change) triggers an alert and attaches diff with actionable hint
Telemetry emitted: rbac.comparator.deltas, rbac.flake.score, rbac.regression.alert with JSON link to snapshot
test_plan: Create 5 synthetic fixture sets that cover role inheritance, resource-scoped grants, and SAML-group mappings
Run comparator in CI against nightly RBAC snapshot and assert no unexpected deltas for control fixtures
Introduce controlled nondeterminism (race in cache refresh) to ensure flake detector spotlights transient failures
Add integration test that wires comparator output into regression suite and validates rollback path (canary policy revert)
Manual verification: review sample diffs in console for three recent customer-facing incidents
implementation_notes: Use existing fixture canonicalizer from ENG-31724 but add stable ordering and salted hashes to prevent accidental ordering diffs
Delta algorithm: field-level and semantic (permission equivalence) comparisons; fall back to text-diff for unknown fields
Flake scoring heuristic: weighted score (freq * 0.6 + host-spread * 0.2 + kv-cache-mismatch * 0.2), threshold 0.7 marks 'likely flake'
Output format: line-delimited JSON blobs with metadata (fixture_id, run_id, service_commit, trace_id) so downstream jobs can link artifacts
Provide a lightweight CLI and a k8s job runner to stage comparator in nightly jobset; avoid coupling to primary regression runner initially
Add feature flag to enable comparator-derived alerts in non-prod environments first and require opt-in for prod alerts
